title: Encyclopedic genre profile (Layer 2 — functional roles)
description: Functional-role vocabulary for ENCYCLOPEDIC documents (Wikipedia / Parsoid articles). A role is an OPTIONAL second label on a layer-1 block; each role declares the layer-1 kind(s) it may attach to.
$comment: Grounds the align_gold wikipedia Parsoid map (infobox/wikitable -> table; thumbcaption/gallerytext -> caption) into named functional roles for the article-furniture rows the class map does not name. Consistency: every role.attaches_to is non-empty.

x-roles.label: Infobox row
x-roles.description: One key/value row of an article infobox (the infobox itself is a layer-1 `table`).

x-roles.label: Hatnote / disambiguation note
x-roles.description: A leading hatnote / disambiguation / for-other-uses note.
profile_edges: references (to the other article it points at)

x-roles.label: See-also entry
x-roles.description: One entry of a See-also / related-links list.
